summary.text: Jane Raybould is a member of the Nebraska Legislature (Unicameral) representing District 28, serving since 2022. Her committee assignments are Agriculture and Business and Labor.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative biography, Raybould was born November 1, 1958, in Lincoln and graduated from Pius X High School in 1977.
She earned a B.A. from Creighton University in 1981 and an M.A. from Georgetown University in 1985.

Her biography lists her occupation as vice president and director of buildings and equipment at B&R Stores, and past service on the Lincoln City Council and the Lancaster County Board of Commissioners.
It lists her as married to Jose Herrero since December 3, 1983, with two children.
